Unlocks the active skill [Deep Freeze]. While Ice is the active mother dragon, every tower's basic attack slows enemies by 50% for 3s.
Reduces [Deep Freeze] cooldown by 12% per rank (up to 24%: 60s to 45.6s).
Extends [Deep Freeze] duration by 1s per rank (3s to 4s to 5s).
While Ice is active, Snow Slime and Snow Crystal output increases by 12% per rank (up to 24%).
While Ice is active, Ice-element towers gain 10% attack speed per rank (up to 20%). Towers of other elements are unaffected.
Unlocks the active skill [Burn Surge]. While Fire is the active mother dragon, every newly spawned enemy burns for 2 damage per second until it dies.
Increases [Burn Surge] damage by 20% per rank (30% of current HP, up to 42%).
Reduces [Burn Surge] cooldown by 12% per rank (up to 24%: 60s to 45.6s).
While Fire is active, Volcano Slime and Flame Heart output increases by 12% per rank (up to 24%).
While Fire is active, Fire-element towers gain 10% damage per rank (up to 20%). Towers of other elements are unaffected.
Unlocks the active skill [Instant Reactivation]. While Time is the active mother dragon, every tower gains 15% attack speed.
Reduces [Instant Reactivation] cooldown by 12% per rank (up to 24%).
Reduces [Instant Reactivation] cooldown by a further 12% per rank. Fully upgrading both active branches totals 48% (60s to 31.2s).
While Time is active, Desert Slime and Time Sand output increases by 12% per rank (up to 24%).
While Time is active, Time-element towers gain 10% attack speed per rank (up to 20%). Towers of other elements are unaffected.
Unlocks the active skill [Meteor Barricade]. While Stone is the active mother dragon, Stone, Rock Slime and Philosopher's Stone output increases by 20%.
Increases [Meteor Barricade] damage by 20% per rank (40 to 56).
Increases the max HP of the barricade raised by [Meteor Barricade] by 50% per rank (50 to 100).
While Stone is active, Stone, Rock Slime and Philosopher's Stone output increases by a further 12% per rank (up to 24%).
While Stone is active, Stone-element towers gain 10% damage per rank (up to 20%). Towers of other elements are unaffected.
Unlocks the active skill [Castle Mend]. While Life is the active mother dragon, Food and Grass Slime output increases by 20%.
Reduces [Castle Mend] cooldown by 12% per rank (up to 24%).
Increases [Castle Mend] healing by 20% per rank (50 to 70).
While Life is active, Food and Grass Slime output increases by a further 12% per rank (up to 24%).
While Life is active, every tower gains 10% max HP per rank (up to 20%), regardless of element. Applied when the night begins.
The tower-attack slow keeps working even while Ice is not the active mother dragon, and [Deep Freeze] cooldown is reduced by a further 20%.
The Ice baby dragon's attacks apply slow (rank 1), and its own damage increases by 12% (rank 2). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Widens the Ice baby dragon's buff radius by 20% per rank (3 to 4.2). Buildings can be placed on volcanic terrain inside that radius.
Enemies keep burning on spawn even while Fire is not the active mother dragon, and [Burn Surge] deals 30% more damage with 20% less cooldown.
The burn applied by the Fire baby dragon deals 2 damage per second (rank 1), rising to 4 (rank 2). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Increases the Fire baby dragon's own attack range by 12% per rank (up to 24%). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Every tower keeps 7.5% attack speed even while Time is not the active mother dragon, and conquest expeditions take 1 day less.
Increases the Time baby dragon's own attack speed by 12% per rank (up to 24%). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Widens the Time baby dragon's buff radius by 20% per rank (5 to 7). Desert terrain penalties are nullified inside that radius.
Half of the production bonus (10%) remains even while Stone is not the active mother dragon, and [Meteor Barricade] daily uses increase from 2 to 3.
Increases the Stone baby dragon's own damage by 12% per rank (up to 24%). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Raises the production multiplier the Stone baby dragon grants to nearby facilities from 2.0x by 0.3x per rank (up to 2.6x). Applies to Stone and the four specialty resources.
Half of the production bonus (10%) remains even while Life is not the active mother dragon, and [Castle Mend] heals 30% more with 20% less cooldown.
Widens the Life baby dragon's buff radius by 20% per rank (3 to 4.2). Applies at all times, regardless of which mother dragon is active.
Raises the production multiplier the Life baby dragon grants to nearby facilities from 2.0x by 0.3x per rank (up to 2.6x). Applies to Food and Wood.
